record_type_quote: The dataset was provided by the GROUP consortium for the replication study, and contains data from healthy controls and relatives of psychiatric patients (specifically, from 1,636 participants with three data collection points).

targets.authors: Van Gastel, W. A., MacCabe, J. H., Schubart, C. D., Vreeker, A., Tempelaar, W., Kahn, R. S., & Boks, M. P. M.
targets.title: Cigarette smoking and cannabis use are equally strongly associated with psychotic-like experiences: a cross-sectional study in 1929 young adults.
targets.evidence_quote: While these outcomes are in line with general understanding of psychotic symptomatology predictors, they do not confirm findings from van Gastel et al. (2013).
targets.outcome_quote: Result: This claim was not replicated. Cigarette smoking was not significantly associated with distress scores (negative, positive and depression) from psychotic-like experiences (PLEs) in the fully adjusted model.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit failed replication verdict for the focal smoking–distress association in an independent existing sample.

reasoning: Secondary data from a different sample constitute replication. File GUID resolves to a completed SCORE report naming Elisabeth Julie Vargo as replication team; assigned metadata lists a broader author team, but focal original, project and report identity agree.
